tha-ap42:1.1: Kapparukkhiya.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato thūpaseṭṭhassa sammukhā / vicittadusse laṅghetvā kapparukkhaṃ ṭhapes' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap42:2.1: Yaṃ yaṃ *yonūpapajjāmi devattaṃ* atha mānusaṃ / sobhayanto mama dvāraṃ kapparukkho patiṭṭhati. // //
tha-ap42:3.1: Ahañ ca parisā c' eva ye keci mama nissitā / tamhā dussaṃ gahetvāna nivāsema mayaṃ sadā. // //
tha-ap42:4.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ rukkhaṃ ṭhapayiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi kapparukkhass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap42:5.1: Ito ca sattame kappe Sucelā aṭṭha khattiyā / sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā. // //
tha-ap42:6.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap42:7.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Kapparukkhiyo thero imā gāthāyo{abhāsitthā} ti.
tha-ap42:11.1: Kuṇḍa-Sāgata-Kaccānā Udāyī Rājasavhayo Adhimutto Lasuṇado Āyāgī Dhammacakkiko. Kapparukkhī ca dasamo gāthā dvādasa sataṃ
